mapper.sql: file_group_id, entity_type, entity_id, site_id, download_auth, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_file_group WHERE file_group_id = #{fileGroupId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT FROM tb_file_group WHERE entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId} AND delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_file_group ( file_group_id, entity_type, entity_id, site_id, download_auth, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{fileGroupId}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{siteId}, COALESCE(#{downloadAuth}, 'ROLE_MEMBER'), 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE entity_type = VALUES(entity_type), entity_id = VALUES(entity_id), site_id = VALUES(site_id), download_auth = VALUES(download_auth), delete_yn = 'N', updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_ip = VALUES(updated_ip), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_file_group SET download_auth = #{downloadAuth}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_group_id = #{fileGroupId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_file_group g JOIN tb_bbs_article a ON a.article_id = g.entity_id AND a.delete_yn = 'N' SET g.download_auth = #{downloadAuth}, g.updated_by = #{updatedBy}, g.updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, g.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE g.entity_type = 'BBS' AND g.delete_yn = 'N' AND a.bbs_master_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND a.notice_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_file_group SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_group_id = #{fileGroupId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_file_group WHERE delete_yn = 'Y' AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
